entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-28
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • SignalR cannot sustain a connection when an app is in the background on iOS #65255
  • Problems when setting up Blazor Web App (.NET 10) with PWA #65254
  • [Blazor SSR] Add built-in navigation and form submission indicators #65250
  • Quarantine Interop.FunctionalTests.Http3.Http3TlsTests.LoadDevelopmentCertificateViaConfiguration #65248
  • [Linux] Failed to publish MVC F# project with error MSB3021 "Unable to copy file ..." #65247
  • Perf regression: mvc, mvc #65246

Closed

  • ASP.NET Core 10 Data Protection has cryptographic errors on Ubuntu 22.04 with FIPS enabled #64597
  • Update BL0007 warning to explain why a parameter should be an auto-property and what to do #51372
    .NET 11 Planning

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/8.0] Add support for hotfix branding #65252
    tell-mode, 8.0.x
  • OpenAPI: Prune null from enum/type in componentized schemas #65251
    community-contribution, feature-openapi, area-minimal
  • fix: Kestrel Http3 LoadDevelopmentCertificateViaConfiguration test stabilization #65249
    area-networking

Merged

  • Avoid re-throwing exception in bad request handling path #65221
    Perf, area-networking, 11.0-preview1
  • fix FIPS enabled context header creation in ManagedAuthenticatedEncryptor #65186
    area-dataprotection, 11.0-preview1
  • Update BL0007 diagnostic to provide clearer guidance on component parameter patterns #63812
    area-blazor, Attention: Shared Code Modified, 11.0-preview1

Updated

  • Document MinResponseDataRate transport buffer limitation #64743
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Antiforgery perf improvements (includes new DataProtection API usage) #64751
    area-perf, feature-antiforgery
  • Update HttpSys shutdown logic #65217
    feature-httpsys, area-networking
  • Add new `webworker` template project #65037
    area-blazor, pending-ci-rerun, 11.0-preview1
  • [10.0] [Blazor] Support NavigateTo when enhanced nav is disabled (#52267) #64724
    area-blazor, pending-ci-rerun
  • Add missing clearing of pooled arrays #63710
    area-blazor, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun
  • [Blazor] Remove build-time disabling of preloading in tests #61667
    area-blazor, feature-blazor-wasm, pending-ci-rerun
  • feat(openapi): support Nullable Description Attribute on enums #65245
    community-contribution, feature-openapi, area-minimal
